# Hadad Yuval Electric — verified business and catalog guide

> חדד יובל אלקטריק בע"מ (Hadad Electric) is a physical home-appliance store at 3 Lohamei HaGeta'ot Street, Nahariya, Israel.

Canonical site: https://hadadelectric.co.il/
Business name: חדד יובל אלקטריק בע"מ
English name: Hadad Electric
Address: לוחמי הגטאות 3, נהריה, ישראל
Telephone and WhatsApp: +972-4-9920948
Primary language: Hebrew
Service area: Nahariya and northern Israel

The website is a product catalog, not an online checkout. Product availability shown on the site is preliminary and must be confirmed with the store. Prices, final availability, delivery, installation and warranty terms are confirmed directly by the store.
